data.exact_reserve_text: Following the annual independent actuarial review, the Syndicate net reserve margins above management's best estimate for the prior years were reduced in 2022 by $28m (2021:$41m increase). The reduction largely relates to reducing uncertainty on the financial and professional lines of business as views on the claims development patterns and the impact of remediation work done to date, including potential for future development and the impact of rate change, become more aligned. In the current year an additional net margin of $12m is held for increased inflation above the impacts included in the management best estimate for the inflation we are seeing. Any inflationary impact on 2019 and prior accident years would be covered by the LPT within the limit of the contract.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Provides $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date; covers 2019 and prior accident years; transfers responsibility and expense of handling 2019 and prior claims to an Enstar subsidiary; operates on a cash-withheld basis for four years.
COVID-19 impact across classes with gross ultimate claims of GBP 29.893m and net ultimate claims of GBP 15.072m (across Accident & Health, Property and Other).

named_events.loss_description: Net ultimate claims of GBP 15.072m across A&H, Property and Other
Exposures arise from aviation reinsurance, credit and political risks and international crisis management insurance exposures; significant uncertainty and few notifications to date.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle, prior-year development (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) shows a net adverse movement of approximately GBP 32.6m (strengthening), driven largely by adverse development in the 2019 underwriting year partially offset by releases on older years. The Managing Agent also reports a reduction of net reserve margins above best estimate of $28m driven by reduced uncertainty in financial and professional lines and remediation work; additionally an LPT with Enstar covering 2019 and prior provides up to $450m of adverse development protection and will affect recoveries and reserve handling for those years. Inflation considerations have prompted an additional net margin of $12m to be held.
raw_causal_phrases: Following the annual independent actuarial review, the Syndicate net reserve margins above management's best estimate for the prior years were reduced in 2022 by $28m (2021:$41m increase).

The reduction largely relates to reducing uncertainty on the financial and professional lines of business as views on the claims development patterns and the impact of remediation work done to date, including potential for future development and the impact of rate change, become more aligned.
In the current year an additional net margin of $12m is held for increased inflation above the impacts included in the management best estimate for the inflation we are seeing.

The LPT covers all business on the 2019 and prior accident years, which means some development on the 2019 Underwriting Year is not reinsured. The LPT provides the Aspen Group with $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 36) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2020. The Managing Agent narrative provides a net movement (reduction in net reserve margins of $28m) which differs in sign/magnitude from the gross PYD derived from the triangle; this reflects differences between gross movement and net (post-reinsurance) movements and the effect of the Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and recognition of retroactive reinsurance. All tabular amounts in the accounts are presented in GBP 000; triangle and reserve computations used those units and were converted to millions for this output. Where only net amounts were given in the narrative these were not used as the primary PYD source (gross triangle used instead).
